title: The Korns and the Biloxi Elks Convention
summary: Laine recalls Marcus and Marty Korn, trombone and clarinet, who worked with him, including a three-day Elks Convention job in Biloxi; he cannot remember all his musicians.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I know the Korns, Marcus and Navi, Korn. What did they play? Trombone and Paranet. Marty, Marty played Paranet. Marcus played Trombone.
I see. And how did they sound? Did they work with you? They put my earmorphs? Yeah,

they worked with me. Yeah, they worked with me. Yeah, I used to have, when I, speaking about Biloxi, I took Marcus up there in a band we played for the Elks Convention. We was up there three days. And, because Marcus, he was an elk. See? And he was playing with my band at the same time. See? So, we were up there three days. Biloxi. Played for the Elks Convention.

Now, as I said, the musicians today, there's so many of them that played with me, I really can't remember them anymore. See? I cannot remember them anymore. You put out, you put out 50 men or something like that, you know, 50 boys in a band or 50, 60, like that. And keeping them going, you'd have to be had with them all the time to remember them.
